description: r0b0tlab's audited production lane for the official DeepSeek V4 Flash DSpark checkpoint (913f0657) on two GB10 Sparks: Anemll's digest-pinned dspark-vllm-gx10 image (vLLM 0.25.2.dev0, FlashInfer 0.6.15), FlashInfer B12X MoE, native DSpark speculative decoding at k=5, NVFP4 MLA KV cache and RoCE tensor parallel 2. Upstream production profile: 200,000 token context, 16 sequences, 16K batched tokens, 0.84 memory utilization. Upstream's 384K and 1M profiles run a different legacy Stage-C image and are not included. Licences: r0b0tlab package MIT AND Apache-2.0, model MIT (information only). Performance figures are upstream claims, not measured here. Absolute KV correction: 15,998,753,178 bytes per rank, the pool of the deepseek-v4-flash-0731-r0b0tlab-vllm-dual sibling (same weights per rank). Concurrency 9 is the most 200,000-token requests that pool holds under the pinned cache-geometry allocation bound; it bounds the scheduler, while vLLM's own accounting fits about 2 full 200,000-token requests in this pool. The creator context is retained. This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash DSpark vLLM 0.25 dual Spark (r0b0tlab)
